# VIPER: ranking readers by skill from scores, and blocks among readers (generated by scripts/viper_skill_and_blocks.py)

True skill = each reader's AUC of the suspicion score against cancer at 455 days. Cells in part A are Spearman correlations across readers between a label-free estimate and the true skill. Soft-label AUCs are leave-one-out: the reader's own scores are not used to fit the aggregator.

## FFDM

Per-reader true AUC: median 0.684, range 0.566-0.779.
